# Profile

My career has moved across several technical worlds: mathematical and environmental modelling, research and experimentation, startup product development, software consulting, and industrial Data Science and AI. I am a multidisciplinary practitioner who is comfortable moving between scientific reasoning, implementation details, and the practical constraints of delivering software.

My scientific foundations include applied mathematics and partial differential equations, with work connected to fluid mechanics, atmospheric dispersion, and environmental modelling. My software experience spans front-end and back-end development, workflow and business-process tooling, enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and Python-based data/AI work.

## What connects the different experiences

- **Scientific reasoning:** translate a real-world problem into explicit assumptions, a model, a numerical or statistical method, and a way to evaluate the result.
- **Engineering:** turn a method or requirement into maintainable software, with attention to interfaces, testing, integration, and operational constraints.
- **Evaluation:** compare approaches using suitable baselines and metrics, examine failure cases, and avoid drawing conclusions beyond the evidence.
- **Adaptability:** move between research, startup, consulting, and software-vendor environments, learning the languages and frameworks required by each context.

## Technical focus

- Applied mathematics, partial differential equations, numerical modelling, and scientific computing
- Statistics, data analysis, classical machine learning, and experimentation
- LLM/NLP, generative AI, benchmark design, and model evaluation
- Python development, software design, automated testing, and maintainability
- Enterprise software, Java/Spring, Scala, JavaScript, cloud services, and container orchestration

The technologies listed across the portfolio represent different depths and periods of experience. They are presented in context rather than as a claim of equal expertise in every tool.

## Working approach

I start by clarifying the problem and its constraints, then connect the relevant scientific or product model to an implementation and an evaluation strategy. I aim to make assumptions, evidence, design choices, and limitations visible—whether the work concerns a numerical model, a software system, or an AI benchmark.
